_doc: Hand curation for the clause register. 'clauses' entries match by text substring (optionally within a section) so they survive renumbering. 'exclude' drops a sentence that uses a keyword without being a rule (meta-talk about keywords). 'set' overrides any field, most often 'side'. 'decision_classes' classifies decisions that ground in no normative clause on purpose. 'invariant_decisions' links the four §1 invariants to the decisions that state them.

clauses.match: It is a SHOULD and will never be a MUST
clauses.exclude: meta: discusses the keyword choice, not a rule

decision_classes._doc: Why a decision has no (or only indirect) normative clause. process = governs the project, not the wire; note = lives in a technical note, never protocol; studio = client-side by design; refusal = a decision NOT to add something; vocabulary = spelling of tokens; deferred = pushed to a later level; foundational = stated as a §1 invariant rather than as clauses.

decision_sections._doc: Hand-traced spec homes for decisions whose records predate the spec or name no section. Added to the parsed spec_sections with via='curated'.
